CMOS power-on reset pulse generator
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 PWL(0 0 100n 0 120n 3.3 10u 3.3 10.02u 0 15u 0 15.02u 3.3 25u 3.3)
XDUT vdd 0 por delay astra_071_cmos_power_on_reset_pulse
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec initial_high range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec initial_clear range -0.02 0.02 unit=V
* @spec repeat_high range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec repeat_clear range -0.02 0.02 unit=V
* @spec width1 range 3e-7 0.0000025 unit=s
* @spec width2 range 3e-7 0.0000025 unit=s
* @spec discharged range 0 0.1 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 1n 25u
meas tran initial_high FIND v(por) AT=300n
meas tran initial_clear FIND v(por) AT=5u
meas tran repeat_high FIND v(por) AT=15.3u
meas tran repeat_clear FIND v(por) AT=20u
meas tran width1 TRIG v(por) VAL=1.65 RISE=1 TARG v(por) VAL=1.65 FALL=1
meas tran width2 TRIG v(por) VAL=1.65 RISE=2 TARG v(por) VAL=1.65 FALL=2
meas tran discharged FIND v(delay) AT=14.8u
write out.raw v(por) v(delay) v(vdd)
quit
.endc
.end
